Build a small polished interactive night-sky motion study in this directory. Keep it a standalone index.html with no external assets or build step. Provide a visible Pause/Play button, a visible Reset button, and a labeled range slider for speed. The Pause/Play button must communicate its state with aria-pressed (true means paused); Reset must pause the animation and reset speed to 1. Support keyboard controls through normal semantic controls, narrow mobile screens, and prefers-reduced-motion (start paused for reduced motion). Make the visual direction intentional, with hierarchy, contrast, and considered motion. Browser-test actual interactions at desktop and mobile sizes, save screenshots under evidence/, and inspect those screenshots before finishing. If browser tooling cannot run, report the exact limitation instead of claiming visual validation. The fixture may contain node_modules/@playwright/test for local browser automation. No publishing or commit is requested.
